name: Thread switch: money → people mid-conversation
description: Prospect starts with budget concerns (money thread) then reveals the real pain is staffing (people thread). Coach must pivot thread when the bigger pain emerges.
callContext:
CALL TYPE: Cold call (first contact)
EXPECTED FIRST CONTACT: Office Manager (decision maker)
COACHING DIRECTIVE: Expected to reach OM directly. Skip gatekeeper plays.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Hey Rachel, I work with practices on phone coverage. Quick question — how are things going?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Budget is really tight right now. We've been cutting costs everywhere.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Budget tight, cutting costs → detect money thread immediately.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Well honestly the bigger problem is we just lost two front desk people. That's why we're behind on everything — can't even answer phones half the time.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: CRITICAL: Prospect pivoted from money to people/staffing. Thread must SWITCH to people. Play 15 (money follow-up) is wrong. Play 14 (people follow-up) is ideal.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Two people at once? That's brutal.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Yeah, and we can't hire fast enough. Patients are going to voicemail and we're losing them.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Stay in people thread. Pain math or pitch territory now — she's acknowledged losing patients.
